input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusivity on us (the Company): for the whole term we may not participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI holds the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer web site. Under Section 4.1 the term is one year but renews automatically each anniversary indefinitely, and exiting requires 90 days' notice plus a Termination Payment under Section 4.2(a), so the restraint effectively runs for the full (open-ended) term with no performance-based release — the only performance exit is the narrow 70-day launch failure right in Section 1.6. That fails the fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic end on HDI's service level/delivery failure) and approaches walk-away territory. Because HDI's development/hosting role and the reciprocal two-year restraint on HDI in Section 6.3 (which benefits us and is left intact) form part of the bargain, we have taken the fallback rather than deleting the covenant: exclusivity is capped at the initial twelve months and ends automatically on HDI's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate
ops.newText: during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date (and not during any renewal term), the Company shall not participate

ops.oldText: directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: directly to the consumer on the Internet. The Company's obligations under this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without payment or penalty, upon HDI's failure to meet any service level, launch date or other delivery date set forth in this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook does not accept exclusivity binding the Company; at most we can live with a defined product category for twelve months that ends automatically if HDI misses its service levels or delivery dates. We have therefore limited Section 6.1 to the initial one-year term and added an automatic performance-based release, leaving HDI's reciprocal exclusivity in Section 6.3 untouched.
proposal.summary: Limit Company exclusivity to 12 months and add automatic exit on HDI performance failure.
